description: This file defines the IniFileMetaInfo class, which encapsulates metadata information for an INI file, including page sizes, signature, total size, and read commands.

classes.name: IniFileMetaInfo
classes.description: A class that holds metadata about an INI file, including number of pages, signature, page sizes, total size, and read commands.

methods.name: IniFileMetaInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the metadata from a RawIniFile object.

methods.name: getBlockingFactor
methods.description: Returns the blocking factor used for reading chunks.

methods.name: getTotalSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the INI file based on individual page sizes.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature string of the INI file.

methods.name: getPageReadCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string to read a specific page.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific page.
